items.q: Which two casts are drawn side by side in a single cell that shares the one association 'Chronic kidney disease'?
opts: Broad cast and waxy cast
RBC cast and WBC cast
Fatty cast and eosinophil cast
Hyaline cast and fine granular cast
items.exp: The row contains two photographs captioned Broad cast and Waxy cast against a single merged cell reading 'Chronic kidney disease'. (Book p746)

items.q: Fill up: In the WBC-cast row, the page expands AIN as acute interstitial ______.
opts: Necrosis
Nephritis
Neoplasia
Nitrogen retention
items.exp: The third bullet of that row is printed as 'Acute Tubular Necrosis (ATN)/Acute Interstitial Necrosis (AIN)' — the abbreviation is expanded as necrosis on this page even though the cast is classically linked with interstitial nephritis. (Book p746)

items.q: The wording 'ATN/AIN' is written against more than one cast row in this table.
opts: True — the tubular epithelial row adds 'most specific' and the eosinophil row carries the bare pair
False — only the tubular epithelial row mentions it
False — the eosinophil row is instead marked 'myeloma'
True — and the RBC cast row repeats it for glomerular hematuria
items.exp: ATN/AIN appears in the WBC-cast bullet list, as 'ATN/AIN (most specific)' for the tubular epithelial (muddy brown) cast and again for the eosinophil cast. (Book p746)

items.q: A post-operative oliguric patient has muddy-brown pigmented casts with renal tubular cells on microscopy. According to this table, that cast is:
opts: The tubular epithelial cast, the most specific marker of ATN/AIN
A pigment fine granular cast, which marks pigment nephropathy
A broad cast, which marks chronic kidney disease
A fractured cast, which marks myeloma
items.exp: The row reads 'Tubular epithelial cast (muddy brown) — ATN/AIN (most specific)', the phrase in brackets being the page's qualifier for this cast alone. (Book p746)

items.q: Each cast row on this page is followed by a bullet list of several associations EXCEPT:
opts: RBC cast, whose cell carries one unbulleted line
WBC cast
Fatty cast
Pigment fine granular cast
items.exp: The RBC cast row shows a single line — 'Glomerular hematuria' — whereas the WBC cast, fatty cast and pigment fine granular rows each carry bulleted lists. (Book p746)
